info.description:
Device Platform API in the swagger-2.0 specification

URL info:
  • Base: https://ip:port/
  • Default port: 8443
  • Port can be changed in /opt/vdcm/embgui/share/config/rest_agent/cp_rest_agent_rel.cfg (key: server.socket_port)

Swagger: https://ip:port/api/swagger.json

Important Notes

All Enums can be extended without an API version increase.
Extra optional elements can be added without an API version increase.
This means that in later releases extra fields and values can be added. Code that uses this interface has to be able to handle this.

Optional blocks that are not provided in the json data are ignored. For a POST this means that the device default behavior is used. For PUT this means that the settings are not updated.

When an existing resource is used in a POST action, the existing resource is updated with the new settings. (e.g. Existing Sources resource used in a new ABRServices POST action)
See also 'Defining data' info in the Models section.

All strings don't allow characters that are seen as a potential issue for cross site scripting ('<' and '>' are not allowed, unless it's an b-tag, u-tag or i-tag and the close tag is present also)

/api/RestConfig
For ABR transcode/encode to be fully in sync with the GUI, to enable full component handling (tracking, merging), and to use linear transcode/encode, 'ComponentHandling' needs to be set to 'Manual' in resource '/api/RestConfig'
More detailed info: RestConfig settings

Starting version V25_03_02, the following response code are also possible:

  • 503: Service Unavailable - This can be returned when the device is too busy to process the request. The client can retry the request after some time.

  • 429: Too Many Requests - This can be returned when the client has sent too many requests in a given amount of time. The client should retry the request after some time.

  • 413: Payload Too Large - This can be returned when the request payload is too large for the device to process. The client should reduce the size of the request payload and retry. (see max_request_body_size_mb and body_size_path_limits)

  • 415: Unsupported Media Type - This can be returned when the request payload is in an unsupported format. The client should check the Content-Type header and ensure that the request payload is in a supported format. (also see content_type_path_overrides)

  • 400: Bad Request - This can be returned when the request payload is invalid or malformed. The client should check the error message in the response body for more details on the issue with the request payload.



Thumbnails

For Sources, OutputTSs, InputServices and OutputServices, a thumbnail can be retrieved using the URL 'https://ip:port/Thumbnails' with the following query parameters
  1. stage:
    • Value: 'input' for Sources
    • Value: 'output' for OutputTSs
  2. data-interface:
    • Value of 'interface' for XGRESS Sources
    • Value of 'interface' for XGRESS OutputTSs
    • 'Local' for all Local input sources(Local File TS, RTMP, ARB2TS, TSoHTTP, ZIXI, SRT, RIST), ASI inputs and OutputTSs of type 'ASI', 'SRT', 'RTMP', 'ZIXI', 'RIST'
    • 'Data<x>' (where x is a number) for Xgress Input/Output and DEPI types
  3. interface-name:
    • Value of 'interface' for ASI Sources
    • Value of 'interface' for ASI OutputTSs
    • Only for ASI (vDCM 24.1.0 and MEG 24.1.0)
  4. ip:
    • Value of 'targetIp' for XGRESS Sources
    • '0.0.0.0' for unicast, Sources of Type 'Local File TS', 'ASI', 'SRT', 'ABR2TS', 'ZIXI', 'ISDB-T', 'ATSC1', 'ATSC3', 'TSoHTTP', 'RTMP' and 'RIST'
    • Value of 'targetIp' for XGRESS OutputTSs
    • '0.0.0.0' for OutputTSs 'ASI', 'SRT', 'RTMP', ZIXI and RIST
  5. udp:
    • Value of 'targetUdp' for Sources
    • Value of 'targetUdp' for OutputTSs
    • not applicable for DEPI OutputTS
    • Optional for ASI. Use either 'interface-name' or 'udp' (vDCM 24.1.0 and MEG 24.1.0)
  6. sid:
    • Value of 'serviceId' for InputServices (If not specified, the thumbnail of Sources would be returned)
    • Value of 'serviceId' for OutputServices (If not specified, the thumbnail of OutputTSs would be returned)
  7. channelId: (Introduced in vDCM 15.0 and MEG 1.0)
    • Name to identify a TS
    • Can be used in place of data-interface,IP and UDP - Returns the thumbnail of the first match.
    • When channelId is provided, it takes precedence over data-interface, sourceIp, ip, udp and vlan
  8. vlanId: (Introduced in vDCM 20.0 and MEG 2.0)
    • Value of 'vlanId' for XGRESS Sources
    • Value of 'vlanId' for XGRESS OutputTSs
    • Value of 'vlanId' is in the range 0-4094 for controlled-video interface. Default value is zero
  9. sourceIp: (Introduced in vDCM 21.1.0 and MEG 3.1.0)
    • Value of 'sourceIp' for XGRESS Sources (only in SourceIP_IP_UDP mode)
    • 0.0.0.0 or not set for IP_UDP mode, other Sources, or OutputTSs
  10. runtime: (Introduced in vDCM 20.1.0 and MEG 2.0.0)
    • This option retrieves the thumbnail in real-time (not a cached version)
    • If 'runtime' is there in query parameters, then only 10 parallel calls will be allowed.
  11. sessionId: (Introduced in vDCM 21.0 and MEG 3.0)
    • Mandatory for DEPI Output TS (for Identification)
To get thumbnails thumbnail generation should first be enabled on the device.
Must be enabled activate streaming for outputs.
Not supported for DVB-S2 input and TSoHTTP output.

Service and stream routing

Use 'POST /api/authenticate' to get a token.
This token remains valid for only 10 minutes. After that you need to authenticate again.
It's a good idea to refresh the token before it expires to avoid authentication errors.
Note that response code 401 indicates an expired or invalid token, so you should re-authenticate to obtain a new token.
Response code 429, which indicates too many requests in a short period of time, should not happen while being authenticated properly. So you generally do not need to worry about it if your token is valid. But if it does occur, you should implement a retry mechanism in the same way you would do for response code 401.
It is not needed to get a new token for each API call.
  • Service routing options:
    • Input > output:
      • POST /api/v3/OutputServiceRoutings
    • Input > processing > output:
      • POST the full flow with:
        • /api/v3/ABRServices
        • /api/v3/ABREncodeServices
        • /api/v2/LinearTranscodeServices
        • /api/v2/LinearEncodeServices
      • POST input > processing and do routing to the output in a separate call
        • See 'descrambledServiceId' in json data for 'POST /api/v3/OutputServiceRoutings'
  • Sources > descrambling [ > processing ] > output
    • supported Sources types for descrambling are: [XGRESS|ABR2TS|ZIXI|SRT|RIST|TSFILE|DVB-S2|ASI|ISDB-T|ATSC1|ATSC3|DVB-T]
    • Sources > descrambling:
      • POST /api/v2/descramblingRoutings
    • descrambling [ > processing ] > output
      • descrambling > output:
        • See 'descrambledServiceId' in json data for 'POST /api/v3/OutputServiceRoutings'
      • descrambling > processing > output:
        • Set 'inputService' to null, and use 'descrambledServiceId' in POST:
          • /api/v3/ABRServices
          • /api/v3/ABREncodeServices
          • /api/v2/LinearTranscodeServices
          • /api/v2/LinearEncodeServices
    • Sources > descrambling > processing > output
      • only for single service descrambling!
      • Set 'inputService' and set 'descrambling' in POST: ('descrambledServiceId' not set or not passed)
        • /api/v3/ABRServices
        • /api/v3/ABREncodeServices
        • /api/v2/LinearTranscodeServices
        • /api/v2/LinearEncodeServices
  • Sources > output (create Loopthrough TSs)
    • POST /api/v2/OutputTSRoutings
  • InputServices > DecodeProcessing > DecodeOutputs (SDIoIP)
    • POST /api/v2/DecodeServices
  • Processing services and output services can have alternates, backups, merges,....
    This can be done using 'POST [resource]/Alternates'
    • sourceServiceId / alternateSourceId / backupServiceId / mergedServiceId / mergedBackupServiceId can be:
      • UUID of InputServices resource
      • UUID of descrambled service (=descrambledServiceId)
      • UUID of ABRServices/ABREncodeServices profile (=profileId)
      • UUID of LinearTranscodeServices/LinearEncodeServices service (=videoSettings serviceId or pip serviceId)
  • Create packager
    • First create an output SPTS (= Single Program TS = an output stream that has exactly one output service) by any of the above ways.
      • Tip: Set 'name' of the 'OutputTSs' resource to be able to use it as 'outputTSName' in the next step
    • POST /api/v2/Packagers
      • 'ats' input streams require 'outputTSName' or 'outputTSId' to refer to the created output SPTS from the first step

FQDN Validation Rules

  • Split on '.' (dot)
  • Validate last part with regex '^[a-zA-Z]{2,63}$' (between 2 and 63 chars from the alphabet)
  • Validate other parts with regex '^[a-zA-Z0-9-]{0,62}[a-zA-Z0-9]$' (between 1 and 63 alphanumeric chars or dash but no dash as last char)
  • 1 part is enough (no dot required)

post.description:
Resource since V14_00_00
Create an ABR Service Encode flow for vMFP-ABR

How are components managed in the ABR flow?
  • Processing Step:
    • Component tracking: 'processing.trackRules' are applied to the components of the main processing service and affects the components of the profile services
    • Video/Audio tracking: 'processing.videoSettings.source' tracking is applied on the result of A.1.
  • Outputs Step:
    • Component merging is done: 'outputs.mergedComponents' is used to merge components from the main processing service to the output service
    • Component tracking: 'outputs.trackRules' are applied to the components of the output service after component merging

get.description:
Resource since V08_00_02
The response contains two extra headers: 'X-Total-Count' and 'Link' (https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc5988)
Note: The messages are in a rotated buffer. The maximum value for the number of the message is 32767, after that it starts back at 1.

Example usage: (V08_00_03)
  1. Start by getting the oldest messages: GET /api/v2/AlarmHistory
  2. From the response: remember 'latestNumber' and use 'Next' link from Link header to get all data in a loop untill you have all data (remembering 'latestNumber' each time)
  3. Now that you have all data, you can start polling 'latestNumber' by doing GET /api/v2/AlarmHistory?count=0&latest=latestNumber
  4. If 'latestNumber' is different, you'll get a 'Next' link in the Link header
  5. Go back to step 2

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description:
Supported since V09_00_00.
Possible values: ['oldest_first', 'newest_first']

parameters.name: type
parameters.description:
Supported since V09_00_01.
Possible values: ['all', 'open']
For open type alarms, other query parameters are not applicable and Response link headers are not present

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Number of elements in response. Use 0 to poll 'latestNumber' ('messages' will return empty list)

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Message number of the first element of the page that is called. If not given or 0, the first element will be the oldest message available.

parameters.name: latest
parameters.description:
Supported since V08_00_03.
Pass the previously returned 'latestNumber' while polling with 'count' set to 0. If alarms were added to the list, a 'next' link will be returned in the 'Link' header if 'latest' still exists in the buffer.

parameters.name: Authorization
parameters.description: 'token' out of response of successful login with /api/authenticate

X-Total-Count.description: The total number of items (Not the number of items in this response)

Link.description: Web Linking format (possible links: First, Next, Prev, Last)

put.description:
Resource since V20_02_00
Steps:
  • PUT will return 'follow_url' (absolute url) (only this value will be returned)
  • Do GET for 'follow_url' untill you get a response (no Authorization needed) (max two minutes)
  • Once you get a response: While 'exit_code' is null and 'follow_url' is not an empty string:
    • The response will also contain the other data fields
      'status_updates' will only contain new info
      To get the full list, call the first 'follow_url'
    • Get new 'follow_url' from response
    • Do GET on this new 'follow_url' after waiting e.g. one second
  • 'exit_code' 0 means success. Any other number means that something went wrong. See received 'status_updates' for details.

parameters.name: find
parameters.description:
Use 'find' to find a specific resource.
Find parameters: ['inputType', 'interface', 'vlanId', 'targetIp', 'targetUdp', 'sourceIp', 'frequency', 'isi', 'serviceId']
Possible argument combinations for find:
  • inputType XGRESS + interface + vlanId + targetIp + targetUdp + serviceId
  • inputType ST2022-6 + interface + targetIp + targetUdp + sourceIp
  • inputType ST2110 + interface + targetIp + targetUdp + sourceIp
  • inputType SDI + interface
  • inputType NDI + streamName
  • inputType ABR2TS|ZIXI|TSFILE|SRT|ISDB-T|ATSC1|ATSC3|RIST|DVB-T + targetUdp + serviceId
  • inputType DVB-S2 + interface + frequency + isi + serviceId

Works together with 'ids_only'.
Introduced in version V14_00_00

parameters.name: inputType
parameters.description:
Value needs to be URL encoded
'find' param is needed to use this
Input source type
Options: ['XGRESS', 'ABR2TS', 'ZIXI', 'SDI', 'ST2022-6', 'ST2110', 'TSFILE', 'SRT', 'ASI', 'ISDB-T', 'ATSC1', 'ATSC3', 'RIST', 'DVB-T', 'DVB-S2', 'NDI']

parameters.name: interface
parameters.description:
Value needs to be URL encoded
'find' param is needed to use this
Datax/SDIx/SDIoIPx where x depends on the number of the data interface
Not needed for Local and RF ports

parameters.name: vlanId
parameters.description:
Value needs to be URL encoded
'find' param is needed to use this
applicable only for XGRESS controlled-video interface

parameters.name: targetIp
parameters.description:
Value needs to be URL encoded
'find' param is needed to use this
use '0.0.0.0' for unicast.
V24_00_00: IPv6 support

parameters.name: targetUdp
parameters.description:

'find' param is needed to use this

parameters.name: sourceIp

'find' param is needed to use this

parameters.name: frequency
parameters.description:

'find' param is needed to use this

parameters.name: isi

'find' param is needed to use this

parameters.name: serviceId

only needed for XGRESS, ABR2TS, ASI, ISDB-T, DVB-T, DVB-S2, ATSC1 and ATSC3

Use 'find' to find a specific resource.
Find parameters: ['interface', 'vlanId', 'targetIp', 'targetUdp', 'tsName', 'outputType', 'sessionId', 'streamName']
Possible argument combinations for find:
  • interface + targetIp + targetUdp
  • interface + outputType + targetIp + sessionId
  • interface + outputType
  • interface + tsName
  • outputType + streamName to find HTTP LTTS

Works together with 'ids_only'.

parameters.name: interface
parameters.description:
Value needs to be URL encoded
'find' param is needed to use this
Data1 to Datax where x depends on the number of data interfaces that are defined.
Ignored in case of outputType HTTP, mandatory for others

parameters.name: vlanId
parameters.description:
Value needs to be URL encoded
'find' param is needed to use this
applicable only for XGRESS controlled-video interface

parameters.name: targetIp
parameters.description:
Value needs to be URL encoded
'find' param is needed to use this
Needed when 'tsName' is not given for Xgress
should be '127.0.0.1' for SRT or RTMP or ZIXI or RIST
Multicast IPv6 for Xgress supported from V21_00_00IPv6 for Xgress supported from V24_00_00

parameters.name: targetUdp
parameters.description:
Value needs to be URL encoded
'find' param is needed to use this
Needed when 'tsName' is not given for Xgress
Mandatory for SRT or RTMP or ZIXI or RIST, should be in the range [26000-26999]

parameters.name: tsName
parameters.description:
Value needs to be URL encoded
'find' param is needed to use this
Name of the output TS.
Needed when 'targetIp' and 'targetUdp' are not given for Xgress

parameters.name: outputType
parameters.description:
Value needs to be URL encoded
'find' param is needed to use this
Type of the output TS.
Default id set to XGRESS

parameters.name: sessionId
parameters.description:
Value needs to be URL encoded
'find' param is needed to use this
Needed only when 'outputType' is set to 'DEPI'

parameters.name: streamName
parameters.description:
Value needs to be URL encoded
'find' param is needed to use this

parameters.name: find
parameters.description:
Use 'find' to find a specific resource.
Find parameters: ['interface', 'targetIp', 'targetUdp', 'vlanId', 'tsName', 'outputType', 'sessionId', 'stream_name', 'sid', 'serviceName', 'powerKeySessionID']
Possible argument combinations for find:
  • interface + targetIp + targetUdp + sid
  • interface + outputType + targetIp + sessionId + sid
  • interface + outputType + sid
  • interface + tsName + sid
  • interface + serviceName (Only if serviceName is unique within the interface, the resource will be returned)
  • [interface +] powerKeySessionID

Works together with 'ids_only'.
Introduced in version V14_00_00

parameters.name: interface
parameters.description:
Value needs to be URL encoded
'find' param is needed to use this
Data1 to Datax where x depends on the number of data interfaces that are defined
Optional in combination with powerKeySessionID

parameters.name: targetIp
parameters.description:
Value needs to be URL encoded
'find' param is needed to use this
Needed when 'tsName' is not given for Xgress
should be '127.0.0.1' for SRT or RTMP or ZIXI or RIST
Not required for HTTP
Multicast IPv6 for Xgress supported from V21_00_00

parameters.name: targetUdp
parameters.description:
Value needs to be URL encoded
'find' param is needed to use this
Needed when 'tsName' is not given for Xgress
Mandatory for SRT or RTMP or ZIXI or RIST, should be in the range [26000-26999], Not required for DEPI/HTTP

parameters.name: vlanId
parameters.description:
Value needs to be URL encoded
'find' param is needed to use this
applicable only for XGRESS controlled-video interface

parameters.name: tsName
parameters.description:
Value needs to be URL encoded
'find' param is needed to use this
Name of the output TS.
Needed when 'targetIp' and 'targetUdp' are not given for Xgress

parameters.name: outputType
parameters.description:
Value needs to be URL encoded
'find' param is needed to use this
Type of the output TS.
Default id set to XGRESS

parameters.name: sessionId
parameters.description:
Value needs to be URL encoded
'find' param is needed to use this
Needed only when 'outputType' is set to 'DEPI'

parameters.name: stream_name
parameters.description:
Value needs to be URL encoded
'find' param is needed to use this
Needed only when 'outputType' is set to 'HTTP'

parameters.name: sid
parameters.description:
Value needs to be URL encoded
'find' param is needed to use this

parameters.name: serviceName
parameters.description:
Value needs to be URL encoded
'find' param is needed to use this
Matches the service name. To use this, the service name must be unique within the interface.

parameters.name: powerKeySessionID
parameters.description:
Value needs to be URL encoded
'find' param is needed to use this
Format: 20 hex characters
Leave out or use empty string to remove the session

parameters.description: Instead of only returning key data for embedded resources, all details will be returned

parameters.name: find
parameters.description:
Use 'find' to find a specific resource.
Find parameters: ['interface', 'targetIp', 'targetUdp', 'vlanId', 'tsName', 'outputType', 'sessionId', 'stream_name']
Possible argument combinations for find:
  • interface + targetIp + targetUdp
  • interface + outputType + targetIp + sessionId
  • interface + targetIp + targetUdp + vlanId
  • interface + tsName
  • interface + outputType

Works together with 'ids_only'.
Introduced in version V14_00_00

parameters.name: interface
parameters.description:
Value needs to be URL encoded
'find' param is needed to use this
Data1 to Datax where x depends on the number of data interfaces that are defined

parameters.name: targetIp
parameters.description:
Value needs to be URL encoded
'find' param is needed to use this
Needed when 'tsName' is not given for Xgress
should be '127.0.0.1' for SRT or RTMP or ZIXI or RIST
Not required for HTTP
Multicast IPv6 for Xgress supported from V21_00_00

parameters.name: targetUdp
parameters.description:
Value needs to be URL encoded
'find' param is needed to use this
Needed when 'tsName' is not given for Xgress
Mandatory for SRT or RTMP or ZIXI or RIST, should be in the range [26000-26999], Not required for DEPI/HTTP

parameters.name: vlanId
parameters.description:
Value needs to be URL encoded
'find' param is needed to use this
applicable only for XGRESS controlled-video interface

parameters.name: tsName
parameters.description:
Value needs to be URL encoded
'find' param is needed to use this
Name of the output TS.
Needed when 'targetIp' and 'targetUdp' are not given for Xgress

parameters.name: outputType
parameters.description:
Value needs to be URL encoded
'find' param is needed to use this
Type of the output TS.
Default id set to XGRESS

parameters.name: sessionId
parameters.description:
Value needs to be URL encoded
'find' param is needed to use this
Needed only when 'outputType' is set to 'DEPI'

parameters.name: stream_name
parameters.description:
Value needs to be URL encoded
'find' param is needed to use this
Needed only when 'outputType' is set to 'HTTP'

post.description:
Resource since V20_02_00
Upload installer file
See PUT /api/v2/AppSettings/Installers on how to start installation

Usage (Example): curl --insecure -H "Content-Type: application/octet-stream" -H "Transfer-Encoding: chunked" -H "Authorization : Bearer $(cat token)" -i --request POST --data-binary @$(cat filename) https://:8443/api/v2/Upload/Installers?file_name=$(cat filename)

For files larger than 2147483648 bytes (2**31): curl --insecure -H "Content-Type: application/octet-stream" -H "Authorization : Bearer $(cat token)" -i --request POST -T $(cat filename) https://:8443/api/v2/Upload/Installers?file_name=$(cat filename)
Note: -T is the same as --upload-file

Resource since V24_03_00. Multipart/form-data support added in V26_00_00.
Upload MPEG-2 Transport Stream file to the TS Player repository

processingDelay.description:
Unit: milliseconds
Default: 5000
For codec H.264 and rateMode CBR the 'processingDelay' value should be in range [900:6000].
For codec H.265 and rateMode CBR the 'processingDelay' value should be in range [2000:6000].
For codec H.264/H.265 and rateMode Smart the 'processingDelay' value should be in range [3000:6000].
'processingDelay' can't be set to less than 2000 when gopBPictures is not 0.
Min value changed from 4000 to 3000 in V16_00_04.
Min value changed to 2000 in V19_00_01.
For HEVC CBR rate control, minimum processingDelay reduced to 2000 in V20_00_00.
For codec AVC/HEVC and rateMode Smart the minimum processingDelay changed from 4000 to 3000 in V20_01_00.
For codec H.264 and rateMode CBR, minimum processingDelay reduced to 900 in V20_01_02.
Can be changed with PUT/PATCH

multicastHighThroughputMode.description:
Default: false
DEPRECATED since V20_02_00 but it's still backwards compatible.
True to use raw sockets for multicast out, this limits kernel processing but disables the possibility of local loopback of multicast streams.
New behaviour in v20.2.0:
In GET call:
- return TRUE if in case all ports have 'High' throughputMode.
- return FALSE if in case all ports have 'Normal' throughputMode.
- return FALSE if in case ports have mixed modes.
- return FALSE in all other cases.
In SET call:
- SET TRUE: Sets all ports to 'High' throughputMode.
- SET FALSE: Sets all ports to 'Normal' throughputMode.
- Not specifying/providing the 'multicastHighThroughputMode' will ignore the setting and not make any changes. - When 'multicastHighThroughputMode' is present(in the JSON) that is used and port level 'throughputMode' are ignored. Only when 'multicastHighThroughputMode' is not present(in the JSON), the port level 'throughputMode' is used instead.

For SD vResolution value 480 and 576, supported scanType values are interlaced and progressive and the default scanType value is interlaced
For HD vResolution value 720, supported scanType value is progressive only and by default the scanType value is progressive
For HD vResolution value 1080, supported scanType values are interlaced and progressive and the default scanType value is interlaced
For FHD vResolution value 1080, supported scanType value is progressive only and by default the scanType value is progressive
For UHD vResolution value 2160, supported scanType value is progressive only and by default the scanType value is progressive

gopSize.description:
Must be smaller than 'maxGopSize'
default: 15

For gopMode KeepClosedGOPs gopSize NotApplicable. For H.266 codec, gopSize is same as HEVC. From V26_01_00, for HEVC, gopSize can be a non-multiple of (gopBPictures + 1) when gopMode is Dynamic.
Can be changed with PUT/PATCH

maxGopSize.description:

processingDelay.description:
Unit: milliseconds
Range: [900:6000] (default: 5000).
For codec H.264 and rateMode CBR/CappedVBR the 'processingDelay' value should be in range [900:6000].
For codec MPEG2 and rateMode CBR/CappedVBR the 'processingDelay' value should be in range [2000:6000].
For codec H.265 and rateMode CBR for UHD 4K/8K the 'processingDelay' value should be in range [2000:6000].
For codec H.264/MPEG2/H.265 and rateMode Statmux for URC the 'processingDelay' value should be in range [4000:6000].
For codec H.264/H.265 and rateMode Smart the 'processingDelay' value should be in range [3000:6000].
'processingDelay' can't be set to less than 2000 when gopBPictures is not 0.
If MCTF_Mode or preDeblockingFilter or IT_Detection is set to Enabled, 'processingDelay' value should be in range [4500:6000].
For MPEG2 Statmux encode, the min value changed from 4500 to 4000 in V17_00_00.
For codec H.265 and rateMode CBR the minimum processingDelay reduced to 2000 in V20_00_00.
For codec H.264 and rateMode CBR the minimum processingDelay changed from 2000 to 900 in V20_01_00.
For codec H.264/H.265 and rateMode Smart the minimum processingDelay changed from 4000 to 3000 in V20_01_00.
AudioOnlyTranscode: [500-6000] (default: 5000)For codec H.265 and rateMode CBR for non-UHD the 'processingDelay' value should be in range [1200:6000].Added in V21_03_00For codec H.264/MPEG2/H.265 and rateMode Statmux for URC2 the minimum processingDelay changed from 3500 to 3000 in V22_01_00.
On AudioOnlyEncode for codec MPEG-L2, AAC_LC and DolbyDigital, 'processingDelay' value should be in range [150:6000] ms.Added in V22_02_00.
On AudioOnlyEncode for codec DolbyDigitalPlus and DDP_ATMOS, 'processingDelay' value should be in range [160:6000] ms.Added in V22_02_00.
On AudioOnlyEncode for codec HE_AACv1 and HE_AACv2, 'processingDelay' value should be in range [210:6000] ms. Added in V22_02_00.
On AudioOnlyEncode for codec Dolby_AC4, 'processingDelay' value should be in range [1300:6000] ms. Added in V22_02_00.
From V24_03_00, For Encoding, when codec H.264 and rateMode CBR/CappedVBR/QC_VBR, the 'processingDelay' minimum value changed from 900 to 750
From V25_00_00, when codec is VVC and enhancementEncoding is Disabled, the 'processingDelay' value should be in range [3000:6000], default:5000. When codec is VVC and enhancementEncoding is EnabledLCEVC, the 'processingDelay' value should be in range [3500:6000], default:5000.
From V25_03_00, when latencyMode is Low and codec is AVC, 'processingDelay' should be in range [750:1199] and when codec is HEVC, 'processingDelay' should be in range [620:1199].
From V26_01_00, when latencyMode is Low and codec is HEVC, processingDelay lower limit is changed from 620 to 520ms
Can be changed with PUT/PATCH

processingDelay.description:
Unit: milliseconds
Range: [900:6000] (default: 5000).
For codec H.264 and rateMode CBR/CappedVBR the 'processingDelay' value should be in range [900:6000].
For codec MPEG2 and rateMode CBR/CappedVBR the 'processingDelay' value should be in range [2000:6000].
For codec H.265 and rateMode CBR for UHD 4K/8K the 'processingDelay' value should be in range [2000:6000].
For codec H.264/MPEG2/H.265 and rateMode Statmux for URC the 'processingDelay' value should be in range [4000:6000].
For codec H.264/H.265 and rateMode Smart the 'processingDelay' value should be in range [3000:6000].
'processingDelay' can't be set to less than 2000 when gopBPictures is not 0.
If MCTF_Mode or preDeblockingFilter or IT_Detection is set to Enabled, 'processingDelay' value should be in range [4500:6000].
For MPEG2 Statmux encode, the min value changed from 4500 to 4000 in V17_00_00.
For codec H.265 and rateMode CBR the minimum processingDelay reduced to 2000 in V20_00_00.
For codec H.264 and rateMode CBR the minimum processingDelay changed from 2000 to 900 in V20_01_00.
For codec H.264/H.265 and rateMode Smart the minimum processingDelay changed from 4000 to 3000 in V20_01_00.
AudioOnlyTranscode: [500-6000] (default: 5000)For codec H.265 and rateMode CBR for non-UHD the 'processingDelay' value should be in range [1200:6000].Added in V21_03_00For codec H.264/MPEG2/H.265 and rateMode Statmux for URC2 the minimum processingDelay changed from 3500 to 3000 in V22_01_00.
On AudioOnlyEncode for codec MPEG-L2, AAC_LC and DolbyDigital, 'processingDelay' value should be in range [150:6000] ms.Added in V22_02_00.
On AudioOnlyEncode for codec DolbyDigitalPlus and DDP_ATMOS, 'processingDelay' value should be in range [160:6000] ms.Added in V22_02_00.
On AudioOnlyEncode for codec HE_AACv1 and HE_AACv2, 'processingDelay' value should be in range [210:6000] ms. Added in V22_02_00.
On AudioOnlyEncode for codec Dolby_AC4, 'processingDelay' value should be in range [1300:6000] ms. Added in V22_02_00.
From V24_03_00, For Encoding, when codec H.264 and rateMode CBR/CappedVBR/QC_VBR, the 'processingDelay' minimum value changed from 900 to 750
From V25_00_00, when codec is VVC and enhancementEncoding is Disabled, the 'processingDelay' value should be in range [3000:6000], default:5000. When codec is VVC and enhancementEncoding is EnabledLCEVC, the 'processingDelay' value should be in range [3500:6000], default:5000.

Can be changed with PUT/PATCH

bitrate.description:
Unit: kbps
Not relevant for xcodeMode Disabled or Passthrough. For codec MPEG_H, allowed bit rates are 384, 448, 640. From V24_01_00, DDP_ATMOS allows 768 bit rate From V24_01_00, for Dolby_AC4 codec, For Stereo outputChannelConfig, 320, 384, 448, 512, 768, 1024 kbps are added and 32 kbps is no longer supported. For 5.x, 320, 384, 448, 512, 768, 1024 kbps are added. From V24_02_00, When codec is Dolby_AC4 and channel config is UpMixTo_5.1.4, applicable bit rates are 192, 256, 288, 320, 384, 448, 512, 768, 1024. When codec is DDP_ATMOS and channel config is UpMixTo_5.1.4/UpMixTo_7.1.4, applicable bit rates are 384, 448, 640, 768
From V25_00_00, DolbyDigital allows following bit rates, For Mono, 56, 64, 96, 192. For Stereo, 96, 128, 192, 224, 256, 384, 448, 640. For 5.x, 224, 256, 384, 448, 640.
DolbyDigitalPlus allows following bit rates, For Mono: 32, 64, 96, 192. For Stereo: 96, 128, 192, 224, 256, 384, 448, 640, 768. For 5.x: 192, 224, 256, 384, 448, 640, 768
Can be changed with PUT/PATCH

Manual : ABR only with v3, component merging and component tracking can be done

Manual is recommended and Managed is deprecated
Behavior when switching between Manual and Managed:
Setting /v2/ABRServices

/v2/OutputServiceRoutings 		/v3/ABRServices
/v3/ABREncodeServices
/v3/OutputServiceRoutings
Managed OK. For ABR, also refer AllowV2_ABR_XCode option Not supported error 403
Manual Not supported error 403 Ok
GUI/IIOP created ABRServices are now also returned
Managed to Manual Not supported error 403 ABRService:

ABR channels are kept - Component merge rule (audio): explicit on output
During this: API calls return 503 - Audio profiles list is empty
GUI/IIOP created ABRServices are now also returned
OutputService:
- Tracking rules and merged components are now returned
Manual to Managed GET ABR channels: Not supported error 403
- Does not return any items
Does not return V3 items
including items that were V2
V3 resources cannot be deleted
Use GUI or cold reboot to cleanup V3

Can be changed with PUT/PATCH

ApiMetricsMode.description:
Default: Disabled
Kept after cold reboot.
Added in V22_02_00
Determine data preloading for API calls /metrics/system[/info], /metrics/application[/info]
- Disabled : Feature disabled. API calls return 409.
- SingleRequest : For each REST call, the internal GET call to get the data is done. Slower performance, but ok if you are not continuously doing the REST GET calls.- DataPreload : The internal GET calls to get the data is done each 30 seconds in a separate thread. The first GET call does the parsing of the cached data, and caches this parsed data. The next call on the same cached data no longer has to do all the parsing.
- DataPreloadAndParse: Same as the previous one, but the separate thread also already does the parsing. The new data becomes available in the REST response only after the parsing is done.
Before V25_02_00: Note that prometheus-exposure needs to be enabled to get system metrics, but not to get application metrics
Can be changed with PUT/PATCH

processingDelay.description:
Unit: milliseconds
Default: 5000
For codec H.264 and rateMode CBR the 'processingDelay' value should be in range [900:6000].
For codec H.265 and rateMode CBR for UHD the 'processingDelay' value should be in range [2000:6000].
For codec H.264/H.265 and rateMode Smart the 'processingDelay' value should be in range [3000:6000].
For codec AV1 and rateMode CBR the 'processingDelay' value should be in range [4000:6000].
'processingDelay' can't be set to less than 2000 when gopBPictures is not 0.
Min value changed from 4000 to 3000 in V16_00_02.
Min value changed to 2000 in V19_00_01.
For HEVC CBR rate control, minimum processingDelay reduced to 2000 in V20_00_00.
For codec AVC/HEVC and rateMode Smart the minimum processingDelay changed from 4000 to 3000 in V20_01_00.
For codec H.264 and rateMode CBR, minimum processingDelay reduced to 900 in V20_01_02.
For codec H.265 and rateMode CBR for non-UHD the 'processingDelay' value should be in range [1200:6000].Added in V21_03_00.
For latencyMode UltraLow, processingDelay is not applicable, since V22_02_00.
From V24_03_00, For codec H.264 and rateMode CBR/CappedVBR/QC_VBR, the 'processingDelay' minimum value changed from 900 to 750.
From V25_00_00, when codec is VVC and enhancementEncoding is Disabled, the 'processingDelay' value should be in range [3000:6000], default:5000. When codec is VVC and enhancementEncoding is EnabledLCEVC, the 'processingDelay' value should be in range [3500:6000], default:5000.
From V25_03_00, when latencyMode is Low and profiles codecs are AVC, 'processingDelay' should be in range [750:1199] and when profiles codecs are HEVC, 'processingDelay' should be in range [620:1199]. If the latencyMode is set to Low latency in case of a mix of AVC and HEVC profiles,then the processingDelay must be configured in such a way that it falls in both the AVC and HEVC Low latency ranges i.e., [750:1199].
From V26_01_00, when latencyMode is Low and profiles codecs are HEVC, processingDelay lower limit is changed from 620 to 520ms.
